name: Broccoli Tofu Casserole
ingredients: ½ tsp black pepper and ¼ tsp turmeric
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C. Steam the broccoli for 4 minutes.
Whisk the soy milk, cornflour, garlic, mustard, nutritional yeast, turmeric and seasoning in a pan and heat for 4 minutes until thick.
Place the broccoli and tofu in a baking dish and pour over the sauce.
Mix the breadcrumbs with the oil and sprinkle on top.
Bake for 25 minutes until golden and bubbling.
note: Nearly 30 g protein per serving with no cheese or cream.
